1: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF MOLENA RELATING TO OUTSIDE BURNING. BE IT ORDAINED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF MOLENA:
2: - (a) Outside burning of leaves and wood products shall be allowed only during daylight hours. Outside burning includes burning in 55 gallon drums and wire rings. All outside fires must be attended by an adult at all times and must be extinguished by sundown. (b) The burning of rubber, plastics, roofing shingles, or any toxic products shall not be allowed at any time. (c) Campfire and outside cook fires shall be allowed after dark if attended by an adult at all times. The burning of leaves after dark shall not be deemed to constitute a camp fire. (d) Any outside burning that becomes a health hazard or obstructs visibility of roadways shall not be allowed. (e) Burning of large piles of brush, rubbish, or other solid wastes or control fires, must be permitted through the Molena Fire Chief and the Georgia Forestry Commission. (f) Any person who shall violate any of the foregoing shall be guilty of an offense against the City and punished as provided in the charter of the City.
